summary: Owned sets enforce their source: ad hoc desired-state writes to members are refused or forced with source debt that the next publication reverts, with an audit mode

replay.detail: Existing owned-set receipts without a policy replay unchanged as enforce=off; new source.* claims fold into the same projections on every replica.

schema.detail: No SQL migration; new claim kinds source.debt.recorded, source.debt.closed and source.audited, owned-set.revised may carry a policy, and set-managed-subject becomes a client-v0 error code.

rules.detail: Sets with an audit or enforce policy gate apply, create in a claimed namespace, stop, start, mission publish and retire, hold, suspend, resume and retire of their members; --force --reason records debt in the same transaction, and publication closes all debt and reverts forced changes.

compatibility.detail: Publishing a policy or subscription members blocks until every admitted fleet member advertises features.source_enforcement=1; only listed publishers may revise a set with a policy.

downtime.detail: No downtime; sets without a policy behave as before.

manual.detail: No user action is required; operators opt a set in with --enforce or --source-policy.

recovery.detail: Publishing the set with enforce off removes enforcement; open debt is closed by that publication.
